questions.question: What do pairwise preferences identify directly?
options: Reward differences under the chosen comparison model, not an absolute universal utility.
A unique zero point for individual response rewards across unrelated prompts.
A scale-invariant objective whose positive rescaling leaves downstream KL regularization unchanged.
questions.explanation: A shared additive offset cancels from every pairwise probability.
optionFeedback: A shared additive offset cancels from every pairwise probability.
Pairwise losses are unchanged by a shared score offset for each compared pair. They do not identify an absolute utility zero.
Changing reward scale changes its balance with the KL penalty. Compare the terms in the actual policy objective.
